title: agentseam bare-ALLOW audit
description: What a bare ALLOW means to each vendor. The rule: a bare ALLOW must land on whatever
the vendor would have done with no hook at all -- usually silence, but on some vendors
silence is a refusal or a hook error, and there the adapter must speak. Each row's
note is the evidence, carrying basis/date only where the source states one; inventing
either would be a claim the reader cannot check. `unverified` rows are deliberately
unresolved: silencing a vendor whose empty response blocks turns every allow into a
denial, speaking to one that reads the word as auto-approve disables the user's own
confirmation -- both directions are guesses, so the gap is recorded instead.
vouch_notes are the two evidence strings bundle() splices into a generated runtime's
degrade() docstring, verbatim so bundle bytes stay frozen.

vouch_speaks.description: cited evidence that this vendor reads an explicit approval word as a real bypass, so a VOUCH may speak it; not every silent row qualifies (codex_cli is silent by the same default, but its parser rejects the word).

warn_speaks.description: cited evidence of a real warning channel distinct from a plain allow. No agent's has been established to that standard yet, and an absent flag is the honest default, not a placeholder.
